update.interpretation: global conditional-logit normalization vs selected-mass conservation; first-order equivalent at delta=0, both ignore a common row offset; unselected entries can change only through global normalizer

selection: exact inherited inner-loss-EMA schedule; all15 DIRECT inner epochs locked before any new outer refit; fresh same-seed outer initialization; original controls retain their original independently selected epochs

bootstrap.object: mean of three complete-seed within-fold ratio C; no risk ensemble; one shared within-fold patient bootstrap

repair_damage: heldout comparable pairs only; credit0,.5,1 with abs risk difference<=1e-8 ties; repair=sum positive credit change,damage=sum negative credit change; report both divided by all comparable weight and conditional baseline-error/correct weight; net must equal C delta
baselines: within-checkpoint off vs matched, isolates local operator
DIRECT vs reused independently trained S16/P16, includes backbone optimization differences
frozen_diagnostics: all30 original S16 checkpoints; all fit and all heldout patients label-blind attention diagnostics; one attention block, two directions, stage-by-stage not fictitious depth

endpoints.secondary: PFI frozen DSS risk transfer only

scope: finite exploratory operator audit in repeatedly developed cohort; no selector ablation, no encoder/head/gate changes, no automatic scaling or budget expansion
privacy: patient risks/checkpoints/maps/identifiers/selected gene lists/donor indices/credentials private; anonymous aggregate reports and source only
